recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, white-background composition featuring a central floral-radial motif of high-contrast portraits, framed by a square of isometric 3D block lettering and topped with heavy, ultra-bold sans-serif display type.
coreVisualRelationships: Central spiral core radiating into petal-shaped portrait frames
Isometric 3D text forming a perimeter frame around the central graphic
Extreme contrast between heavy black header type and white negative space
Symmetrical balance with rotational orientation of text and imagery
coreInvariants: Central spiral or hypnotic focal point

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A central flower-like arrangement of 7 oval portraits occupies the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The heavy, black, ultra-bold title at the top of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top title, move down to the central spiral, then rotate clockwise following the perimeter text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space between the header, the perimeter frame, and the central motif.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White background providing high-key negative space.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black for primary typography and high-contrast photographic shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted green and blue used exclusively for the 3D isometric extrusions.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with extreme value contrast (pure black vs pure white).

letterConstructionRules: Header: Ultra-expanded, heavy weight with minimal counters.
Perimeter: Isometric extrusion with a 45-degree upward or downward projection.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the main title are pushed together until they almost touch (tight tracking).
Perimeter text is rotated 90, 180, and 270 degrees to form a square.

treatment.depth: isometric extrusion in green or blue

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy display face paired with outlined isometric secondary text and functional metadata sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, blocky presence of the top header.
Good base for the isometric perimeter text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a white square canvas. In the center, place a black and white halftone spiral. Surround the spiral with 7 black petal-shaped masks containing high-contrast, grainy black and white portraits of men. Leave ample white space around this central motif.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a heavy, ultra-expanded black sans-serif title at the top. Create a square frame around the central graphic using four lines of isometric 3D text; the top and bottom lines should have blue extrusions, and the side lines should have green extrusions. Add small metadata text in the top corners.

verificationChecks: Does the perimeter text form a perfect square?
Are the portraits high-contrast black and white?
Is the top title the heaviest visual element?

postGenerationChecks: Check that isometric text is readable from its respective orientation.
Ensure the central spiral does not bleed into the portraits.
Verify the top header is perfectly centered.
Confirm the 3D extrusions use flat colors without shading.
recipe.reuseFormula: Isometric Frame + Radial Portrait Motif + Ultra-Bold Header + High-Contrast B&W + White Negative Space
